title: Listen and Choose a Response — Birthday Party

questions.stem: Will you be at Sarah's party on Friday?

options.A: She had a party last Friday, too.
options.B: I have to work late, but I'll try to stop by.
options.C: Yes, I was there all night.

questions.explanation: The answer gives a reason and a tentative plan, which suits a question about attendance; the tense-mismatched option refers to the past.
